## Workstream and routing (required)
- [ ] **Toolkit:** head `toolkit/<topic>`, base `stable/toolkit`
- [ ] **Decomp:** head `decomp/<topic>`, base `stable/decomp`
- [ ] Grandfathered existing research PR: legacy head preserved, new base checked

## Evidence and safety
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` and `BRANCHES.md` read on the correct current branch; live head fetched.
- [ ] `PROGRESS.md` updated in the implementation/research commit.
- [ ] Appropriate toolkit tests or strict decomp original-ROM/ELF/relocation/inventory/full local CI actually run and results stated.
- [ ] No cross-branch wholesale merge, sensitive game assets, ROMs, or unsupported promotion claims.
- [ ] Topic branch can be deleted after merge once unmerged unique work is accounted for.
